settings.heading: Find your fit.
settings.body: A little attention to proportion makes choosing easier.

settings.heading: Read the silhouette first.
settings.body:
Look for descriptions such as fitted, relaxed or draped. They describe the intended shape, not a guarantee of how a particular size will fit.

Use the front, side and back views together. Notice the shoulder, waist and hem rather than relying on the size label alone.

settings.heading: Use the product details.
settings.body:
Size options and available information vary by item. Compare any supplied measurements with a similar garment you own. Do not assume that the same label means the same measurements across products.

These are demonstration products. Where supplier measurements are unavailable, we do not invent a size chart or fit guarantee.

settings.heading: Still deciding?
settings.body: Save pieces with the heart while you compare silhouettes. Include the product name and your question when contacting us.
